blurb: Griffo Distillery produces a variety of premium spirits and seasonal creations using local ingredients that reflect Sonoma County. They offer contract distilling services including brandy production for wineries. Their spirits include single varietal brandies aged in original wine barrels and coffee liqueurs made with premium coffee blends.
